description.value: The study examined associations between alcohol use severity, age, sex, and gray matter morphometry using voxel-based morphometry and surface-based morphometry in adults aged 18 to 55 years.
Participants were pooled from existing studies and the analysis was cross-sectional.

name.value: AUDIT association with VBM gray matter

definition.value: AUDIT showed global negative association with GM above and beyond the large global effect of age.

value: AUDIT showed global negative association with GM above and beyond the large global effect of age, in 13 clusters for VBM.
Higher AUDIT scores were negatively associated with GM volume in bilateral cerebellum and distributed frontal, temporal, parietal, and occipital regions.
These findings support global rather than regional associations of GM with heavy alcohol use, with medium effects over and above age and other covariates.

name.value: AUDIT association with SBM gray matter

definition.value: AUDIT showed global negative association with GM above and beyond the large global effect of age.

value: AUDIT showed global negative association with GM above and beyond the large global effect of age, in 11 clusters for SBM.

Higher AUDIT scores were negatively associated with GM volume in the left lateral orbitofrontal, supramarginal, precentral, superior temporal, middle temporal, inferior parietal, and other cortical regions.
Cortical thickness showed stronger negative associations with AUDIT than surface area, indicating that SBM volume effects were driven by reductions in cortical thickness.

name.value: Age association with VBM gray matter

definition.value: Age was negatively associated with gray matter volume.

value: Age showed strongly negative associations with GM volume, with the peak age effect observed in the right caudate for VBM.
Age showed a large global negative association with GM volume, above which alcohol use severity had additional medium negative effects.

name.value: Age association with SBM gray matter

definition.value: Age was negatively associated with gray matter volume.

value: Age showed strongly negative associations with GM volume, with peak age effects observed in two frontal clusters for SBM.
Age showed a large global negative association with GM volume, above which alcohol use severity had additional medium negative effects.
